Como CCO, a missão será estruturar e conduzir a estratégia comercial de forma integrada, traduzindo direcionamentos em planos executáveis e decisões bem priorizadas, com liderança madura sobre uma estrutura executiva ampla e impacto direto na previsibilidade de resultados e na sustentabilidade do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir a agenda estratégica do negócio comercial, conectando leitura aprofundada de mercado, posicionamento competitivo, proposta de valor, pricing e canais;
  • Traduzir direcionamentos estratégicos em planos executáveis, com prioridades claras, sequenciamento lógico e acompanhamento rigoroso;
  • Estabelecer critérios de priorização e alocação de recursos, assegurando foco em um ambiente de alta complexidade;
  • Consolidar a gestão orientada por dados como base das decisões executivas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e leitura crítica dos indicadores;
  • Implantar e sustentar ritos de gestão que assegurem ritmo, disciplina e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Liderar diretamente uma estrutura executiva ampla, incluindo diretores regionais e frentes corporativas;
  • Desenvolver lideranças, estabelecer padrões de gestão e garantir alinhamento entre estratégia central e execução regional;
  • Atuar como ponto de integração entre frentes corporativas e regionais, assegurando coerência estratégica e clareza decisória;
  • Conduzir decisões comerciais com visão econômica integrada, considerando impactos em capex, opex, margem e retorno;
  • Promover a evolução organizacional por meio da revisão de estruturas, processos e modelos, com postura analítica e investigativa.


Qualificações

  • Trajetória executiva em ambientes complexos, com operações de escala, múltiplas unidades ou atuação multi-regional;
  • Experiência em negócios de serviços, tecnologia, infraestrutura, consumo recorrente ou mercados correlatos, com forte interface entre estratégia e execução;
  • Histórico consistente de liderança de estruturas executivas amplas e responsabilidade direta por decisões e resultados;
  • Forte atuação com dados, inteligência de mercado e métricas de performance como base decisória;
  • Capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos, priorizar iniciativas e sustentar execução disciplinada;
  • Leitura econômica apurada e conforto para tomar decisões com informação incompleta, assumindo responsabilidade por riscos e impactos;
  • Vivência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou atuação equivalente será considerada diferencial relevante.

title: Designer Gráfico — Consultoria em Negócios Jurídicos B2B
description:
Sobre a Javali


A Javali é uma consultoria de negócios jurídicos. Ajudamos escritórios de advocacia empresarial a crescerem com estratégia, conteúdo e posicionamento. Não somos agência de marketing. Trabalhamos lado a lado com sócios de escritórios que faturam milhões e precisam de inteligência de mercado para se diferenciar e não apenas de posts bonitos para Instagram.

Somos um time pequeno, com profundidade alta no mercado. Nossos clientes são exigentes, trabalhamos temas sofisticados, com impacto visual visível. Quem entra aqui tem autonomia real e responsabilidade proporcional.


Esta vaga combina com você se…


•      Você quer executar dentro de um padrão visual já definido, com agilidade e atenção a detalhes e não esteja procurando posição para liderar direção criativa ou comandar equipe.

•      Você é designer gráfico aplicado a marketing, com experiência em criação de peças de redes sociais, e-books, apresentações comerciais e não está em transição para UX/UI ou Product Design.

•      Você domina as ferramentas certas para cada entrega, sem fanatismo. Se você acredita que \"ferramenta X é a única séria\" e não usa o resto, você vai se frustar aqui.

•      Você tem ao menos 1 ano de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer ou ainda fez um estágio único de 12+ meses contínuos com responsabilidades reais. Aqui você vai aplicar o que já sabe;

•      Sua estética é corporativa, institucional, sóbria. Se seu portfólio mostra cuidado com hierarquia, clareza e linguagem visual profissional, vai casar bem.


O que você vai fazer
  • Produção diária de peças gráficas para uma carteira de clientes (escritórios de advocacia). O trabalho é volume com qualidade dentro de padrão.
  • Peças para redes sociais (50% do tempo). Posts, stories, carrosséis e capas para LinkedIn (principal canal B2B jurídico) e Instagram. Você adapta a partir de templates e diretrizes visuais já definidas para cada cliente. Não é criação do zero o tempo todo. É execução inteligente dentro de um padrão.
  • Diagramação de materiais (30% do tempo). E-books de 30+ páginas, apresentações comerciais, propostas, newsletters, relatórios e materiais institucionais. Conteúdo chega pronto ou semi-pronto. Seu papel é transformar texto denso em layouts limpos. Clareza e ritmo de leitura importam mais do que efeito visual.
  • Adaptações e desdobramentos (15% do tempo). Adaptar peças entre formatos e plataformas, ajustar materiais existentes, criar variações a partir de um key visual aprovado.
  • Organização de arquivos (5% do tempo). Manter pastas organizadas, nomear arquivos corretamente, respeitar padrões de entrega. Parte do método.


Stack esperada


  • Base sólida: Photoshop e Illustrator em nível intermediário a avançado (tratamento de imagem, vetorização, ajustes finos).
  • Produção ágil: familiaridade com ferramentas de criação rápida para volume de social e materiais simples (Canva Pro, Figma ou equivalentes).
  • Apresentações: PowerPoint ou Google Slides para institucional e comercial.
  • Diferencial real: InDesign para diagramação editorial densa, motion (After Effects, CapCut), IA generativa aplicada a design, experiência prévia em mercado jurídico, financeiro ou serviços profissionais.


Requisitos não negociáveis


1 a 5 anos de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer gráfico

•      Portfólio acessível (link de Behance, Dribbble, site pessoal ou PDF)

•      Capacidade de trabalhar com volume, múltiplos clientes e prazos curtos sem perder qualidade

•      Atenção a detalhes: revisão de textos nas peças, alinhamentos, consistência entre formatos

•      Disponibilidade para híbrido em SP (presencial 3x/semana na região do Paraíso)

•      Aceita contratação PJ


Processo seletivo


Triagem por currículo + portfólio · Entrevista · Teste prático visual · Conversa final.



O que oferecemos


•      Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado

•      Modelo híbrido (presencial em SP, 3x por semana + remoto)

•      Autonomia real: você terá clientes e entregas sob sua responsabilidade

•      Exposição a um nicho de alta complexidade e alto valor — negócios jurídicos é um mercado que você dificilmente encontra em outro lugar

•      Espaço para crescer. Quem entra e entrega, evolui rápido.

title: Gestor(a) Extração
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Extração para atuar no nosso time de Processos - Extração.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Promover cultura da segurança nas operações da sua área, através de um ambiente cada vez mais seguro e com pessoas capacitadas e treinadas nas suas atividades;

Garantir a disponibilidade OEE e qualidade do processo de extração, analisando o desempenho dos equipamentos, visando minimizar o tempo para a tomada de medidas corretivas/preventivas e assegurando a continuidade do funcionamento dos mesmos, bem como a qualidade do produto;

Atuar junto ao time de manutenção, na construção do planejamento de manutenção relacionado à área, regulagem de moendas e execução do plano, a fim de assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos;

Fazer gestão de custos e controle de insumos das operações sob sua responsabilidade, acompanhando aderência ao orçamento;

Coordenar trabalhos executados por terceiros, prestando todo suporte para execução das atividades, a fim de garantir a qualidade dos resultados;

Fazer gestão do time, utilizando metodologias de acompanhamento, feedback e desenvolvimento; Promover melhoria contínua da área, através das ferramentas de gestão da rotina, sugerir ações que minimizem interrupções e perdas, garantindo que o processo aconteça sem interrupção e os resultados do planejamento sejam atingidos.


Quais os requisitos?

Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Materiais, Química ou afins;

Sólida vivência com extração por moendas e difusores;

Experiência com projetos de triangulação de moendas, bem como metodologias de gestão de processos e melhoria contínua (SDCA, PDCA, Kaizens e etc);

Experiência com gestão de pessoas, processos e custos.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Supply Plannig specialist
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.


You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.


Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!


We are currently looking for a Supply Plannig Specialist to join us at Sumaré, Brazil . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.



Responsibilities:

  • Analyze medium- and long-term capacity (6 months to 5 years).
  • Develop footprint scenarios and plant capacity balance.
  • Identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks, and future needs.
  • Support investment decisions, prioritization, and capacity allocation.
  • Prepare budgets related to capacity and operations.
  • Create and maintain scenarios in SAP IBP, applying best practices.
  • Support S&OP planning cycles with structured analyses and recommendations
  • Provide support to S&OP and S&OE teams by working in a stewardship role.
  • Drive inventory optimization initiatives linked to cost and service.
  • Migrate reports to Power BI and build executive-level dashboards with reliable data.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, AI, and process standardization.


Profile:


  • The ideal candidate will have a strong background project management, planning process improvement , or planning system implementation.
  • Solid knowledge and hands-on experience with SAP IBP and Power BI is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • 5 years of experience as a Supply Planning Specialist or Senior Supply Planning Analyst within the manufacturing or logistics industry.


*Please attach your Cv in English



What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.


Organization


Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

title: Analista de Gestão de Pessoas Sênior (Treinamento Colheita)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

  • Levantar necessidades de treinamento junto às lideranças, áreas técnicas e demais steakholders.

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: May 7, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need.


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil


Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: May 7, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled


Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?


If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.


About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.


IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.


Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics


Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics


Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments


Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays


Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data


WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need.


HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho
description:
VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!


Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.


Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.


Atividades:

  • Contribuir para a implantação de programas voltados a saúde dos colaboradores, como também na implementação da realização do PCMSO e seus ASOs, conforme preconiza a NR7;
  • Atender os colaboradores em geral, verificando a necessidade de cada situação e zelando pela ética na realização destes bem como no repasse de informações;
  • Atender as solicitações médicas quando necessário;
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de campanhas voltadas a prevenção e promoção a saúde do trabalhador;
  • Realizar treinamentos quanto solicitados com temas relevantes a saúde dos colaboradores;
  • Organizar e manter limpo o ambulatório, bem como também arquivar documentos, e alimentar o sistema com informações necessárias.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Técnico de Enfermagem, com especialização em enfermagem do trabalho e registro no COREN ativo.

title: Vendedor
description:
Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 156 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além. Fazer parte da empresa significa integrar uma equipe que valoriza dedicação, trabalho em equipe e desenvolvimento profissional, oferecendo suporte e ferramentas para o crescimento e construção de carreira dos AutoZoners


Vaga: Vendedor


Descrição do Cargo:


Responsável por realizar atendimentos e fechar vendas por canais digitais (WhatsApp) e telefônicos, com foco em conversão e fidelização de clientes. Atua de forma proativa na prospecção e manutenção da carteira de clientes, realizando vendas ativas e acompanhando oportunidades. Também é responsável pelo gerenciamento do caixa comercial, garantindo o controle e a segurança dos valores movimentados.


Descrição da vaga:


  • Realizar atendimentos comerciais via WhatsApp e telefone, prestando suporte ao cliente durante todo o processo de venda;
  • Efetuar o fechamento de vendas com foco em conversão e satisfação do cliente;
  • Realizar vendas ativas, entrando em contato com clientes da carteira e da base RAC (Recuperação de Ativos de Clientes), promovendo produtos e serviços;
  • Manter relacionamento contínuo com os clientes, identificando oportunidades de recompra e fidelização;
  • Gerenciar o caixa da unidade, incluindo abertura, fechamento e controle de valores recebidos;
  • Garantir a correta movimentação financeira, zelando pela segurança e integridade dos recursos;
  • Registrar informações de vendas e atendimentos em sistemas internos, assegurando a atualização e organização dos dados;
  • Colaborar com a equipe comercial para o alcance de metas e indicadores de desempenho



Qualificações:


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Pacote Office – básico;
  • Experiência em vendas e gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva (diferencial);
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6x1 de segunda a sábado.



Informações Adicionais


  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios oferecidos: assistência médica, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio com academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e 20% de desconto em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Que tal fazer parte dessa jornada?

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

About BCG Platinion

BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.

We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.

Aberto para todos os níveis, desde perfis iniciantes à perfis de liderança.

The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG’s ability to successfully meet our clients’ demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next-level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting-edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Empresa: Multinacional francesa | Mercado premium | Atuação externa.

Local: Curitiba/PR

Regime: PJ

Modalidade: Híbrido


A empresa oferece:

O profissional irá atuar de forma consultiva na prospecção, desenvolvimento e gestão de clientes do mercado de construção de alto padrão, garantindo crescimento sustentável, posicionamento premium da marca e excelência no relacionamento.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar e desenvolver relacionamento com construtoras, incorporadoras, arquitetos, engenheiros e especificadores;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, entendendo necessidades técnicas e propondo soluções adequadas;

  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e projetos de médio e longo ciclo;
  • Desejável experiência nos segmentos de construção, arquitetura, soluções técnicas ou materiais de alto padrão.

  • CNH ativa e disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Inglês ou francês será um diferencial.


A empresa oferece:

  • Remuneração fixa e comissões competitivas
  • Notebook corporativo
  • Carro da empresa

  • Combustível
  • Reembolso de todas as despesas de viagem

title: Mechanical Engineering - CATIA V5
description:
RESUMO:

O profissional escolhido estará inserido na Engenharia do Produto de uma multinacional, envolvido no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas para linha branca e no modelamento 3D de componentes e conjuntos de grande complexidade utilizando o CATIA V5.

Formação superior ou cursando Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas afins .

title: Coordenador Comercial
description:
A RG Think Food é uma consultoria de estratégia e inovação com quase 30 anos de mercado, especializada exclusivamente em alimentos e bebidas. Trabalhamos com clientes como MBRF, Mãe Terra, Natural One, Grupo Flora, Bimbo, Gomes da Costa, Santa Helena, Nestlé, Unilever , entre outros — da estratégia de portifólio, marcas e inovação a programas de relacionamento e produção de conteúdo visual.


Nosso hub fica na Vila Nova Conceição, em São Paulo — com escritório, espaço de co-criação e estúdio de produção culinária.


Estamos contratando um Coordenador Comercial para desenvolver e gerir nossa carteira de clientes na indústria de alimentos e bebidas.


A posição atua em parceria direta com o Diretor de Growth e Marca , conduzindo o ciclo comercial com autonomia — da prospecção ao fechamento — e trabalhando junto ao time de projetos para construir propostas customizadas. Não vendemos prateleira: cada proposta é desenhada a partir do contexto e do desafio real do cliente.


O que você vai fazer


→ Prospectar e qualificar indústrias de alimentos e bebidas

→ Vender o portfólio completo: estratégia, inovação, ativação com nutricionistas e produção de conteúdo

→ Construir propostas customizadas em parceria com o time técnico

→ Gerir carteira ativa e identificar oportunidades de expansão

→ Reativar relacionamentos com ex-clientes e contatos do setor

→ Gerir pipeline no Monday.com e reportar à liderança

→ Representar a RG em eventos e feiras estratégicos do setor


Quem buscamos


→ Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou correlatas

→ 4 a 8 anos em vendas B2B de serviços ou soluções complexas, preferencialmente em consultorias

→ Perfil entre prospecção ativa e relacionamento de longo prazo

→ Comunicação executiva, escuta ativa e humildade intelectual

→ Organização e disciplina para gestão de rotina comercial

→ Familiaridade com LinkedIn, email marketing e ferramentas de outreach.

→ Interesse genuíno pelo universo de food e saúde

→ Inglês


Diferenciais


→ Vivência em boutique de estratégia ou consultoria

→ Passagem pela indústria de alimentos e bebidas


O que oferecemos


→ Regime PJ | Híbrido 4×1 | São Paulo — Vila Nova Conceição

→ Estacionamento gratuito

→ Atuação em parceria com liderança sênior da indústria

→ Portfólio diversificado com múltiplas portas de entrada comercial

→ Oportunidade real de crescimento em empresa em expansão

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services

Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Global Business Development Executive (U.S. Immigration)
description:
Company Description

National Niner Law Firm | Licensed ABS, is a U.S. Law Firm that specializes in guiding individuals and businesses on their journey to the United States. Our experienced team provides assistance with U.S. 

immigration processes, including company creation and exploring the best pathways to achieve clients' goals. With a global approach, we offer services in multiple languages, including Spanish and Portuguese, ensuring personalized support for a diverse clientele.


The Opportunity

Your Market, Our Authority

Do you live in a city or territory where successful professionals and entrepreneurs are looking for a way to move to the United States? Do they need a trusted path to a Green Card backed by licensed U.S. attorneys?


We are looking for Global Business Development Executives to act as the commercial face of our firm in their local markets. This isn't a traditional \"job\"-it is an opportunity to lead your own territory with the full backing of a world-class legal \"factory.\"


The Partnership: We Provide the Engine, You Drive

Total Autonomy: You are the CEO of your own growth. We won't micromanage your hours or your methods; we focus entirely on your results.


No Immigration Expertise Required

You do not need to be a lawyer. We provide the \"legal brain,\" all necessary product training, and a world-class legal engine. Your job is to build the relationship and close the deal; our Scottsdale-based attorneys handle the complex filings and legal strategy.


No \"Safety Net\" Leads

We are looking for hunters. This is an entrepreneurial role for professionals who have the network and the drive to generate their own pipeline from scratch.


The Ultimate Relocation Incentive

We want our best performers working beside us. Exceptional results create a direct pathway for U.S. Visa sponsorship evaluation (O-1/EB-2 NIW) to relocate and join our headquarters in Arizona.


The Rewards

Estimated $4,000 USD Commission Per Contract: High-margin, transparent compensation for every successful client.


$200k+ Annual Earning Potential: Based on a closing rate of just one client per week, with absolutely no cap on your total income.


Product Authority

Represent the most sought-after U.S. immigration products (EB-2 NIW and Corporate Formation).


Zero Overhead

You run your territory; we provide the entire legal and administrative infrastructure.


Who You Are

A sophisticated closer with a proven track record in high-ticket or consultative sales.


A self-starter who wants the prestige of a law firm title with the freedom of an independent executive.


  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is highly valued for global expansion.

title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager

Location: South America Region

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Tire Sales Manager with a strong background in selling semi-steel products. The ideal candidate will have significant experience in managing or working with retail tire stores and will be responsible for expanding our presence in this sector, driving sales growth, and building long-term relationships with clients.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and execute sales strategies to promote and sell Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire products, including all Channels,especially retail stores in the region/country .

- Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the region/country, expanding our client base and opening new accounts.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with retail store managers, owners, and other stakeholders to maximize sales opportunities.

- Provide detailed product knowledge to customers and assist them in making informed purchasing decisions.

- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to stay ahead of industry developments and adapt sales strategies accordingly.

- Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to ensure that our products meet customer needs and that promotional efforts are aligned with sales objectives.

- Achieve sales targets and regularly report on performance metrics to management.

Qualifications:

- A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in tire sales, with a focus on Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire products.

- Strong experience in retail store management or sales within the tire industry.

- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing long-term client relationships.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

-Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize tasks.

- Knowledge of the tire industry and market trends is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Previous experience in opening new retail accounts and developing retail store networks.

- Familiarity with market dynamics and customer needs in the Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire segment.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Product Designer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY


At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries. Design is how we make that feel effortless.


As a Product Designer, you’ll sit at the intersection of design, technology, and business, turning complex ideas into intuitive, well-crafted experiences that solve real problems for real people. You won’t just be designing the experience; you’ll be an active partner in defining it. You’ll focus on consolidating and elevating our web experience across our family of brands (Busbud, Buson, Recorrido, and more), working in a tight-knit team of two designers and reporting to the Lead Product Designer.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


  • End-to-End Ownership: Drive the full design lifecycle, from early-stage exploration and concept development to final hand-off and implementation.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, translate business goals into design solutions, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Craft & Execution: Leverage our robust design system to move directly from concept to high-fidelity execution, bypassing low-fidelity wireframing to prioritize speed and visual precision.
  • Iterative Design: Use data, user research, and performance metrics to continuously refine the product, moving fluidly between exploration and execution.
  • System Thinking: Contribute to and evolve our design systems to ensure a scalable, consistent, and efficient experience across the entire product.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


  • Foundational Excellence: 5+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to simplify complex problems with strong visual craft.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in cross-functional environments where you can communicate design decisions and storytell the vision to engineers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Figma and a solid understanding of scalable design practices, with fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Quality & Autonomy: An obsessive attention to detail and the ability to own your time and priorities without hand-holding. We don’t believe in micromanagement.


Additional Assets


  • Experience with design systems and multi-brand product families.
  • Visual or graphic design skills.
  • Basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.


THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE


Your work will directly influence the daily experience of millions of travelers, driving satisfaction and overall product success. By balancing user empathy with business objectives, you’ll help us build products that are both meaningful and highly functional.


  • Intuitive solutions that align with user needs and ship on time.
  • A maintainable, scalable design system that empowers the whole team.
  • Consistent, high-quality experiences that support our long-term business goals.

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

Atuação na região Central - Polo CTO no modelo hibrido


Nessa função você vai:


No Itaú, as plataformas de IA e GenAI já operam em escala real, suportando modelos fundacionais, agentes autônomos, pipelines de inferência e workloads intensivos em computação.


O grande desafio da nossa squad é claro:


Reduzir o Time-to-Market de projetos de Dados, IA e Inovação, garantindo plataformas cloud robustas, seguras, eficientes e automatizadas, prontas para suportar alta demanda de compute, dados sensíveis e integrações complexas.


Essa vaga é para quem quer atuar no core da engenharia de plataformas de IA construindo a infraestrutura que viabiliza LLMs, agentes e RAG em produção com confiabilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos.


Ser a pessoa engenheira responsável por habilitar os recursos necessários para provisionamento de plataformas de IA, como recursos e serviços em Cloud garantindo que times de produto consigam colocar soluções de IA em produção com velocidade e segurança.


Aqui, cloud não é apenas infraestrutura. É plataforma de aceleração de IA.



Como Cloud é tratado aqui / Cloud não é tratado como:

  • Provisionamento manual
  • Ambientes isolados por projeto
  • Infraestrutura estática
  • Cloud aqui é:
  • Padronizada e reutilizável
  • Infraestrutura como codigo, desde o design
  • Base para workloads de IA escaláveis e observáveis
  • Fundamento para custo eficiente em compute intensivo


O que você vai construir

  • Plataformas cloud para IA e GenAI, suportando:
  • LLMs, agentes autônomos, RAG e pipelines de inferência
  • Ambientes de treino, experimentação e produção
  • Arquiteturas cloud escaláveis e resilientes, cobrindo:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud
  • Ambientes containerizados e orquestrados:
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)
  • oIngress controllers, service mesh e load balancing L4/L7
  • Infraestrutura como Codigo (IaC):
  • Terraform e CloudFormation
  • Padrões reutilizáveis e versionados
  • Pipelines CI/CD e automação:
  • Deploy de aplicações, modelos e infra
  • Integração com fluxos de MLOps / AIOps
  • Observabilidade completa de plataformas de IA:
  • Monitoramento, logging, tracing
  • Troubleshooting de workloads distribuídos
  • Otimização de custos em IA (FinOps):
  • Compute intensivo (GPU/CPU)
  • Dimensionamento eficiente para treino e inferência
  • Networking cloud avançado:
  • VPC/VNet, subnets, routing e DNS
  • Load Balancers, ingress e service exposure
  • Conectividade híbrida (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)


Perfil que buscamos


  • Já construiu ou operou plataformas cloud em ambientes críticos
  • Entende que IA exige infra diferente de sistemas tradicionais
  • Gosta de trabalhar com segurança, automação, padrão e escala
  • Consegue equilibrar:
  • Performance
  • Confiabilidade
  • Custo
  • Tem visão de cloud como produto de plataforma, não apenas como ambiente


Conhecimentos essenciais

  • IA e GenAI:
  • LLMs, agentes, RAG
  • Entendimento do ciclo de vida de IA: dados ¿ treino ¿ modelos ¿ inferência
  • Plataformas Cloud:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Containers e orquestração:
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infraestrutura como Cdigo:
  • Terraform, CloudFormation
  • CI/CD e automação
  • Observabilidade e troubleshooting
  • FinOps e otimização de custo em compute intensivo
  • Networking cloud e conectividade híbrida:
  • VPC/VNet, DNS, routing
  • Load balancers L4/L7, ingress controllers
  • VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute



Por que essa vaga é estratégica

  • Você vai habilitar IA em escala, não s subir infraestrutura
  • Seu trabalho reduz lead time, não s incidentes
  • Cloud tratado como plataforma e acelerador de inovação

  • Familiarity with public, private and/or international education systems.
  • IB Educator Network experience or other IB‑related roles desirable.
  • Fluency in English; additional languages desirable.
